protocol.exposure: All seven matches have previously been inspected. Development CV only; no untouched final test.
protocol.refit: If eligible, refit selected head on all seven public matches at fixed settings. CV measures training procedure, not this final artifact on unseen matches.
protocol.selection: Complete 15-cell out-of-fold evidence; equal-cell spellF1 then macroF1 then name among eligible models, baseline always eligible.
protocol.split_policy: Control training excludes every match in the scored fold. Frozen dead head trained WOH/WOY; neither is scored. Train on remaining catalog matches.
